scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the Children Studying in 1st to 7th and 8th to 10th Class
other_conditions: Worker must be engaged in building or other construction work
Worker must be registered under the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Children or the registered male worker's wife must be enrolled in any grade from Class 1st to 10th
Only two children or a registered male worker's wife are entitled to the scholarship
benefits_summary: Provides ₹2,500 per child for classes 1‑7 and ₹5,000 per child for classes 8‑10.
